# Temple interior tiles, 16x16.  The Ember Temple uses the 'cinder' region
# swap, so the basalt greys here come out warm; the same blocks serve every
# later temple under a different swap.
# Palette: 0 ink, 1 shadow, 2 slate, 3 stone, 4 ash, 5 mist, 6 white, 7 bone,
#          8 sand, 9 wood, a bark, c blood, d red, e ember, f gold, k sea,
#          m ice, q rust
